title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: the Past due ranges split at 30, 60 and 90 days exactly
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has eight open bills on today's date: one not yet due, and one each 1, 30, 31, 60, 61, 90 and 91 days past its due date.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-17 Boundaries; the bills are $10.00, $1.00, $30.00, $31.00, $60.00, $61.00, $90.00 and $91.00 in that order.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/P Unpaid Invoices is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with only {Vendor-A} ticked in the Vendor filter and every group expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Past due filter, tick "1-30 days" only.
  2. In the Past due filter, untick "1-30 days" and tick "31-60 days".
  3. In the Past due filter, untick "31-60 days" and tick "61-90 days".
  4. In the Past due filter, untick "61-90 days" and tick "91+ days".
  5. In the Past due filter, tick all four ranges.
  6. In the Past due filter, untick all four.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Totals row reads $31.00: only the bills 1 and 30 days past due remain (expand the groups to see them).
  • Step 2: $91.00: only the 31 and 60 day bills.
  • Step 3: $151.00: only the 61 and 90 day bills.
  • Step 4: $91.00: only the 91 day bill.
  • Step 5: the chip reads "Past due: 4 ranges" and the bill that is not yet due is gone (Totals $364.00).
  • Step 6: "Past due: Any" and all eight bills show (Totals $374.00).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R15: “The Past due chip and its open menu are the same native checkbox dropdown as Customer and Location: label "Past due", an hourglass icon, an "Any" row, the native line "All ranges are included. Pick one or more to narrow." while none is ticked, then "1-30 days", "31-60 days", "61-90 days", "91+ days", in that order; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Past due: Any" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the range when one is (for example "Past due: 91+ days"), and "Past due: N ranges" when N are. Ticking all four reads "Past due: 4 ranges", not Any, because Any also keeps invoices and bills that are not due yet. The ranges are the reports' own aging buckets: 1 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90 and more than 90 days past the due date on the as-of date.”
  • S5-R16: “With ranges ticked, A/R Detail, A/R Collection, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices keep only the invoices and bills whose days past due on the as-of date fall in a ticked range, and always keep credit memos, deposits and vendor credits.”
  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
